```{julia}
using StatsBase
using CairoMakie

# ---- paste your recovery times here ----
add_times = [
    405, 414, 452, 524, 371, 189, 574, 416, 402, 421,
    301, 420, 305, 411, 349, 306, 288, 642, 606, 388,
    394, 442, 493, 351, 385, 303, 330, 655, 357, 460
]

rem_times = [
    371, 0, 833, 286, 535, 443, 530, 951, 443, 458,
    788, 460, 500, 573, 317, 393, 399, 476, 485, 427,
    419, 0, 371, 519, 429, 2263, 0, 387, 390, 436
]

# ---- ECDF helper: returns x,y step-curve coordinates ----
function ecdf_step_coords(data::AbstractVector{<:Real})
    xs = sort(collect(data))
    n  = length(xs)
    ys = (1:n) ./ n
    # Step plot points: (x0,0)->(x1,0)->(x1,y1)->(x2,y1)->...
    xstep = vcat(xs[1], repeat(xs, inner=2))
    ystep = vcat(0.0, repeat(ys, inner=2)[1:end-1])
    return xstep, ystep
end
function ecdf_step_coords(data::AbstractVector{<:Real})
    xs = sort(collect(data))
    n  = length(xs)
    ys = (1:n) ./ n

    xstep = vcat(xs[1], repeat(xs, inner=2))       # length 1 + 2n
    ystep = vcat(0.0, repeat(ys, inner=2))         # length 1 + 2n

    return xstep, ystep
end
```

```{julia}
labelsize = 24
ticksize = 20
x_add, y_add = ecdf_step_coords(add_times)
x_rem, y_rem = ecdf_step_coords(rem_times)

fig = Figure(size=(800, 450))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1],
    xlabel = "Recovery time Δt_rec (epochs)",
    ylabel = "Fraction recovered",
    #title  = "ECDF of re-specialization times",
    xgridvisible=true, ygridvisible=true,
    xlabelsize=labelsize,
    ylabelsize=labelsize,
    xticklabelsize=ticksize,
    yticklabelsize=ticksize,
)

@show length(x_add) length(y_add)
lines!(ax, x_add, y_add, linewidth=3, label="Add 1 task")
lines!(ax, x_rem, y_rem, linewidth=3, label="Remove 1 agent")

# Optional: show the horizon you simulated
vlines!(ax, [5000], linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)

axislegend(ax, position=:rb, labelsize=ticksize)

# Optional: tighten y-limits
ylims!(ax, 0, 1.02)
```
